_comment: Your spoke's pointer back to the AgentArmy hub. Synced from the hub; do not edit here. A sandboxed spoke agent reads this to find the hub — it does NOT need (and usually cannot reach) the hub's board directly.
how_to_work: Your work queue is THIS repo's Issues — not the hub board. Before coding, read the governing decisions at adrs_url and the inter-layer contracts at contracts_url. Then: pick an Issue (label agent-army-task = complex/multi-file, copilot-task = bounded), implement it, and open a PR whose body contains `Closes #<issue>`. Hub PM/scrum-master hand you epics as [EPIC] Issues opened in this repo; decompose them into Stories/PRs locally.
reporting: automatic — .github/workflows/notify-hub.yml dispatches your PR-merges / issue-closes / comments to the hub. You do not relay manually and do not need the hub Epic number or board access.
